points.quote: | `common` | Any environment. It uses only core JavaScript, with no DOM and no Node. | `common` only |
| `browser` | A browser or renderer, with DOM and Web APIs. | `common`, `browser` |
| `electron-sandbox` | The sandboxed Electron renderer, with DOM plus the preload-exposed Electron bridge. It was formerly `electron-browser`. | `common`, `browser`, `electron-sandbox` |
there are also variants such as `electron-utility`, for utility processes. These follow the same pattern, importing `common` and `node` plus their own folder.
| `electron-main` | The Electron main process, with Node plus Electron main APIs. | `common`, `node`, `electron-main` |
